1.01A.title: DELTARUNE Hotfix Patch
1.01A.intro: We are releasing a hotfix to remedy some issues occurring in the game on PC&Mac. You can confirm the version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.

items.text: Fixed a common crash in a room with a lot of screens.
Fixed a crash when a certain boss tries to summon enemies.
Fixed a freeze involving talking to a character after getting off of a raft.
Fixed a freeze when checking binoculars.
Removed a visible debug message.
Fixed a crash involving picking up grass and swapping characters frame perfectly.
Fixed a part where you can erroneously enter an empty room.
Backtracking to a puzzle after attaining a special armor no longer crashes the game.
Added a failsafe if you don't have audio output during rhythm games segments.
Fixed an issue where pressing up on the keyboard was required to move out of a present, regardless of key binding.
Small graphical alteration to a certain scene.

1.01A.footer: We are aware of many other remaining issues, so we will be issuing another patch soon! After everything is hotfixed on PC, we will target consoles next. (Getting patches approved takes time, so we want to include as many fixes as possible at once.)

1.01B.title: DELTARUNE Hotfix Patch
1.01B.intro: We are releasing a hotfix to remedy some issues occurring in the game on PC&Mac. You can confirm the version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.

items.text: Fixed a softlock where you can get teleported to the Green Room during the battle with one of the final bosses, and be permanently unable to progress if you save. (This fix prevents the issue from happening again, but unfortunately if you had this bug occur, your save file will still be broken.)
Fixed a softlock where the raft could get stuck in a wall.
Fixed a crash if you lose to the first miniboss with zero points.
Fixed a depth issue with a black tile.

Some players’ computers are not compatible with the method of video display in Chapter 3. if you reach a cinematic which crashes or freezes your game, returning to that scene once more will give you the option to skip it.
Fixed a bug when receiving a prize for attaining the highest rank.
After defeating a certain a boss, if your inventory is too full to receive the armor in the chest, a treasure chest will be placed into the Green Room.
Fixed an issue where the game would crash when loading a file from Chapter 3.
Fixed a crash with a scene that could happen at the end of an area.
Fixed an issue of trapped in the closet.

1.01B.footer: We are aware of many other remaining issues, so we will be issuing one last hotfix patch soon! After the next hotfix is on PC, we will generate a patch for consoles.

1.01C.title: DELTARUNE Hotfix Patch
1.01C.intro: We are releasing a hotfix for PC & Mac to remedy some issues occurring in the game. You can confirm the version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.

items.text: Fixed crashes relating to Shadowguy's Sharpshoot ACT.
Removed key combinations that caused various issues across the game.
Fixed a crash relating to talking to an NPC when it's raining.
Strengthened imagery while maintaining a scene's intended meaning.
Fix of trapped out the closet.

1.01C.footer: We will begin the process of issuing the previous patches (1.01A and 1.01B) to consoles soon. The next patch will take longer and address non-fatal bugs. After that, we will take some more time to consider other adjustments.

1.02.title: DELTARUNE v1.02 Patch
1.02.subtitle: (Switch/Switch 2: 1.02, PlayStation 4: 1.03, PlayStation 5: 01.000.003)
1.02.intro: We have issued a new bugfix patch for all platforms (PC / Mac / Consoles). After updating, you can check the version numbers in the bottom right

items.text: Fixed an issue in the room with fireworks where the floor switch can be pressed by an invisible character.
Key Items received from the Ball Machine no longer incorrectly persist outside of that room. This caused numerous issues, including not being able to receive the Shadow Crystal from a certain boss.
Fixed an issue where Susie and Ralsei would appear completely shadowed if defeated by a boss's attack.
In a room where Susie destroys houses, she no longer stops moving erroneously after the battle.
However, she now slides around erroneously. Apparently this is better.
Attempted to fix issues on Board 1 where you can see duplicate Ralseis as well as make Ralsei disappear indefinitely.
Fixed some situations were borders were not displaying correctly.
Fixed some places where the characters were the normal color in an area that has abnormal coloration.
Fixed an issue where it's possible to get temporarily stuck in a playable piano.
Fixed an issue during an optional battle where damage numbers done to the players were not visible.
Additionally, the heal numbers were moving further to the right every time they appeared.
Removed the erroneous appearance of a duplicate Kris in the closet.
Fixed various display issues with the microphone select menu. Additionally, fixed a potential softlock if you have no microphones attached.
Fixed an exploit where you can generate infinite untouchable cats if you touch them with the backside of the shield
Fixed a misalignment of the petting effect and the mouse position.
Fixed a crash if you saved your game in the "Mike Zone" on Nintendo Switch, then imported your save file to Nintendo Switch 2 and continued from there.
"Master Volume" setting now persists between Chapters when using the same file.
Fixed the way the controllers are handled to alleviate some issues with TV-docked Steam Decks.
Fixed an issue on certain Mac systems where the full-screen mode would resize improperly when returning to the main menu from Chapter 4.
Fixed some small hiccups which caused the gameplay to pause for a moment when a scene was loading.
Updated the save data import messages when first launching the game.

Now, if you have more than one app's save data on your console (for example, if you have saves from both the older version of the Chapter 1&2 demo as well as the newer version), it will display them as a list so you can choose the one you want to import. (Note: The import messages only appear if you have no existing save data for the full version of the game...)
Fixed an issue where the game displays at the wrong size on 1440p.
Additionally, there are several other minor aesthetic fixes across chapters 2, 3, and 4.

1.02.footer: Testing of the next patch is already underway. The next two patches contain some extremely slight adjustments to gameplay in addition to bug fixes.

1.03.title: DELTARUNE v1.03 Patch
1.03.subtitle: (Switch/Switch 2: 1.03, PlayStation 4: 1.04, PlayStation 5: 01.000.004)
1.03.intro: We have issued a new bugfix patch for all platforms (PC / Mac / Consoles). After updating, you can check the version numbers in the bottom right of the file select screen for each respective chapter.

items.text: Fixed an instance where fighting Jevil could occasionally crash the game.
Fixed a softlock in the part where you catch mice in a basket on your head.
Fixed a crash in an optional keyboard puzzle.
Fixed an occasional crash on the file load screen.
Swords used in a certain boss's "Sword Tunnel" attack now have a reduced hit box relative to the graphic, making the attack easier to dodge.
Fixed a softlock on the Board 1 that could occur after using only three keys.
Fixed a soft lock if a party member fails to reach the Power Croissant.
Fixed a crash if you pushed a pyramid the wrong way.
Fixed an issue where on certain platforms, the sprites of the game would become blurry after the Tenna scene.
Fixed a visual issue where after defeating Tenna, it was erroneously showing texture data instead of static.
If you lose to Jackenstein 2 times in a row, the amount of damage that the chasing pumpkin deals will be halved. If you lose 3 times in a row, TP gain will be increased by 50%.
These changes will allow players who find this battle difficult to progress past it more easily.
Fixed a softlock which could occur if the tutu was not returned to you.
Fixed an issue where normal battle music would not play if you fought Mike at the beginning of the game.
(This issue becomes resolved after fighting Jackenstein.)
Fixed an issue with a hitbox not working when a boss dives at you from many different directions.
(The hitbox will be adjusted more later)
Fixed an impossible note on the song "Knock you Down!!" in the rhythm game.
Fixed an issue where Kris would still appear to be wearing their church clothes even though they'd been removed.
Fixed an issue where asking Ralsei advice for a puzzle would simply result in him saying a single button.
Fixed an issue where changing octaves on the giant piano organ thing could freeze the game.
Susie and Ralsei no longer erroneously appear in the rhythm game at Castle Town at the end of the Chapter.
Various Chapters
Fixed an issue where changing the language setting would also change the border setting.
Fixed an issue where the intro prophecy would always be skipped after selecting a chapter using a controller.
Fixed a few minor textual errors.
Fixed various minor graphical errors.
Various other minor fixes.

1.04.title: DELTARUNE v1.04 Patch
1.04.subtitle: (Switch/Switch 2: 1.04, PlayStation 4: 1.05, PlayStation 5: 01.000.005)
1.04.intro: We have issued a new bugfix patch for all platforms (PC / Mac / Consoles). After updating, you can check the version numbers in the bottom right

items.text: Added a method to get "TripTicket" even after receiving "ShadowMantle".
You can no longer erroneously keep Lancers in your inventory.
Susie doesn't slide weird after battle in that room where she kicks the houses. Apparently this is better.
Fixed an obscure softlock during the Pushing Buddies sequence.
Fixed a frame perfect game crash if you throw a shell and check it as it's breaking.
Fixed a frame perfect crash involving checking water-logged binoculars.
You can get the "SpinCake" from the "Top Chef" if you gave him the "TopCake" in the "Chapter1".
Reduced the speed of the bullets on one of Jackenstein's attacks.
Fixed an obscure issue if you used "OldMan" ACT and then spared Guei before the attack started.
Toriel no longer answers the phone at the beginning of the Chapter.
You can no longer check a nonexistent snack tray.
Fixed an error where "DualHeal" ACT could be skipped in certain scenarios.
Fixed an error where Susie's turn would be skipped if she used an item during the boss of the Second Sanctuary.
Fixed an issue with the minigame "Main Performance" where barely matching the correct colors would cause them to not light up.
Intentionally getting hit with cats at the end of a battle no longer softlocks the game.
Various Chapters
Fixed various minor visual errors.
Fixed minor text and font issues.
Fixed an issue where your customized keyboard controls could be reset when connecting a new controller.
Fixed an issue where plugging in USB and Bluetooth controllers simultaneously could cause repetitive button presses.

1.05.title: DELTARUNE STEAM BETA BRANCH - PATCH 1.05
1.05.intro: This time, adjustments to gameplay are rather insignificant, but we made two global changes 1.05 to a beta branch on Steam before giving it a full release. If anybody was just going to play the game for fun, it would be appreciated if you could play Multiple Chapters

items.text: We had to upgrade our version of GameMaker to fix a PlayStation-specific bug. The game will now run at 30 FPS (as intended) instead of 31-32 FPS on PS4 and PSS. Ideally there should be no other changes as a consequence of this upgrade, but we just want to make sure.
Cutscenes are now loaded more efficiently. This will reduce hiccups on PlayStation, as well as on weaker PCs. (For most players, there should be NO CHANGE.)
Fixed a combination of inputs that would crash the game in several shops.
A couple other minor fixes.
When facing bosses that swing down with a hammer, the hitbox of the attack now better matches the area shown by the preceding flash.
Fixed a bug which would generate empty items in your Dark World inventory if you used the Bandage in the Light World.
We are not working on any other patches at this time. Instead, we want to concentrate all of our resources on completing Chapter 5.
We would like to give a progress update on the status of Chapter 5 next month (September 2025)
via a newsletter.

0.0.241.title: DELTARUNE PC/Mac Hotfix Update
0.0.241.intro: Today we released an update for PC/Mac to fix a few issues with the game. You can confirm the chapter version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.

items.text: Fixed a softlock when using a Flirt ACT against a pink-colored enemy when the music becomes slow towards the end of the battle.
Fixed a softlock when pressing Z&X simultaneously when interacting with a disappearing fox. Also fixed another bug in the same scenario.
Fixed a crash when knives spawn from an aqua-colored enemy.
Fixed a crash when collecting candy from a green-colored enemy.
Fixed a situation where Kris could be gigantic and the game was unplayable if you had modified your save file in a previous chapter.
The last boss of the chapter will now get gradually easier after losing an excessive amount of times in one play session.

0.0.241.footer: We will continue to address issues as quickly as we can. We will also submit a patch to consoles as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience and for playing the game!

items.text: Fixed a crash towards the end of the game in an area with a yellow guy in the background.
Fixed a crash involving a small glove.

Opening a pink door at a precise location no longer makes the screen go black.

0.0.243.intro: Today we released an update for PC/Mac to fix a few issues with the game. You can confirm the chapter version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.

items.text: Fixed a bug where losing to the last boss of the chapter, leaving the area without saving, then getting a game over elsewhere would result in the file failed to load (dogcheck) screen.
Fixed a crash in a room where you can spend Pink Coins.

0.0.247.title: DELTARUNE Chapter 5 v0.0.247 Patch
0.0.247.intro: Today we released an update for PC/Mac to fix a few issues with the game. You can confirm the chapter version number on the bottom right of the file select screen. GAME CHANGES

items.text: You will no longer receive JusticeAxe from the hole in the CastleTown cliff if you never got the Shadow Crystal in Chapter 4 on that file slot.
Grazing the bullets of an aqua miniboss no longer erroneously makes the attacks last longer.
Fixed an error where the bread-smashing time attack wouldn't display a 0 digit correctly.
Fixed an error where an armor that is supposed to increase the amount of invincibility frames did not work against the chapter boss.
Fixed various memory leaks, which seem to have been causing random crashes on Playstation 4.
Fixed a softlock where you can clip through the floor after defeating certain platforming encounters.
Fixed a softlock when using Rude Buster in the first phase of the platforming battle before the chapter boss.
Fixed an error where scissors would no longer be damaging after an event.
Fixed the SOUL visually remaining in the birdcage if the Chapter’s first scene was skipped in a certain way.
Fixed various circumstances where two textboxes can overlap, or where you can walk around with the menu still open.
Fixed train blueprints hovering in the air, and various other minor graphical fixes.
Various other minor fixes.
TEXT CHANGES
The shop in the Cliffs has new dialogue in an extremely obscure circumstance.
Credits have been added for the following people: Matt Cummings - Festival Concept Art Zu Ehtisham - Platforming VFX Marcy Nabors - Music Assistance
The manual in Castle Town now mentions Susie's SCYTHEMARE.
« Various minor fixes.

0.0.247.footer: We will continue to address issues as quickly as we can. Thank you for your patience and for playing the game!

0.0.250.title: DELTARUNE Chapter 5 v0.0.250 Patch
0.0.250.intro: Switch/Switch 2 versions will follow in the coming days/weeks once they pass certification. You can confirm the chapter version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.

items.text: A Golden Tenna Statue will now appear in Castle Town in Chapter 5 if you got it from the Ball Machine in Chapter 3.
The ability to permanently re-enable Voice Clips has been shoddily added if you lose to the Chapter Boss and have them disabled.
‘In Chapter 4, defeating a Titan Spawn with violence no longer erroneously counts as "Lost".
We also fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where Jackenstein would not appear in your town because of this.
Susie now has additional magic points in Chapter 5 if you defeated the Shadow Crystal boss of Chapter 4.
Fixed some issues where the number on the TP display was occasionally inaccurate.
You can no longer incorrectly leave a certain scene by frame-perfectly opening the menu in the Light World.
Fixed an issue on Nintendo consoles where a wired controller would always take priority over a wireless controller. Now, the controller in slot 1 will always have priority.
Fixed an issue where on gamepads, ZL / L2 would count only as a single frame press of confirm in
Fixed an issue involving bugged blank item slots which had been carried over from Chapter 4 save files before it was fixed in that chapter.
Fixed an issue where you can clip through the floor after fighting three scarecrows by immediately opening the ACT menu, and other bugs involving the ACT menu.
You can no longer crash the game by hitting an enemy and a Mysterious Statue at the same time.
(Unless you can)
You can no longer walk around during combat by interacting with Final Starwalker on the same frame you engage a battle. (And other similar issues)
Fixed various scenarios where you can move around with the menu open.
Fixed certain bullet patterns not giving TP when grazed.
Kris will no longer stay sideways if you enter into the final cutscene of Chapter 5 sideways.
Fixed MANY other minor issues, visual or otherwise.

NEXT TIME In the next patch, we will add an option to nerf the bombs of the Shadow Crystal boss after losing to them once. Additionally, we plan to fix a small number of bugs in previous chapters which had gone unaddressed up until this point.
There is no plan for another extensive Chapter 5 patch after the next one.
Instead, we will resume fully concentrating our development resources on Chapter 6 and 7.
